build_binary_IVF_index: build a binary IVF index with 10 clusters using faiss index_binary_factory with string BIVF10
build_binary_flat_index: build a binary flat index using faiss index_binary_factory with the BFlat factory string
build_binary_HNSW_index: build a binary HNSW index with 32-bit codes using faiss index_binary_factory with string BHNSW32
